mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (MESSAGE_ID, CHAT_ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, MESSAGE_TYPE, CONTENT, IMAGE_URL, SYSTEM_TYPE, PLACE_NAME) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{chatRoomId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{systemType}, #{placeName})
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, CHAT_ROOM_ID AS chatRoomId, SENDER_ID AS senderId, MESSAGE_TYPE AS messageType, CONTENT AS content, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, SYSTEM_TYPE AS systemType, PLACE_NAME AS placeName, SENT_AT AS sentAt, CASE WHEN IS_READ = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS read FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}

SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, CHAT_ROOM_ID AS chatRoomId, SENDER_ID AS senderId, MESSAGE_TYPE AS messageType, CONTENT AS content, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, SYSTEM_TYPE AS systemType, PLACE_NAME AS placeName, SENT_AT AS sentAt, CASE WHEN IS_READ = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS read FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE CHAT_ROOM_ID = #{chatRoomId} ORDER BY SENT_AT ASC, MESSAGE_ID ASC

SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, CHAT_ROOM_ID AS chatRoomId, SENDER_ID AS senderId, MESSAGE_TYPE AS messageType, CONTENT AS content, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, SYSTEM_TYPE AS systemType, PLACE_NAME AS placeName, SENT_AT AS sentAt, CASE WHEN IS_READ = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS read FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE CHAT_ROOM_ID = #{chatRoomId} AND MESSAGE_ID > #{afterMessageId} ORDER BY SENT_AT ASC, MESSAGE_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_MESSAGE SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE CHAT_ROOM_ID = #{chatRoomId} AND IS_READ = 'N' AND (SENDER_ID IS NULL OR SENDER_ID <> #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE CHAT_ROOM_ID = #{chatRoomId} AND IS_READ = 'N' AND (SENDER_ID IS NULL OR SENDER_ID <> #{userId})
